changelog: **Survey engine data model and the anonymity library** (#1879, epic #1877; docs/surveys.md). Five new tables — `Survey`, `SurveyQuestion`, `SurveyInvitation`, `SurveyResponse`, `SurveyAnswer` (new tables only; `Survey`, `SurveyInvitation`, `SurveyResponse` in `TENANT_MODELS`, the two child models deliberately not, as the schema comment explains). Three anonymity modes: IDENTIFIED, CONFIDENTIAL and ANONYMOUS — for ANONYMOUS, `submitSurveyResponse()` (`src/lib/surveys.ts`) writes `respondentId` and `invitationId` NULL at insert and stamps the invitation `respondedAt` instead, proven by `e2e/survey-schema.spec.ts` reading the row back. `src/lib/surveyPrivacy.ts` (pure) decides who reads an individual answer — never for ANONYMOUS, never the respondent's own mentor in any mode, ADMIN only on IDENTIFIED — and applies the response floor (`SURVEY_MIN_RESPONSES` = 5, raised per survey, never lowered) with residual suppression so a hidden group cannot be derived by subtraction. Question keys and types freeze once a survey leaves DRAFT (409 `questions_locked`). The shared field-type union and `validateResponse()` land in `src/lib/forms/schema.ts` in #1800's shape; NPS validates as a 0–10 scale through it. Invitation tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes. Admin API `GET/POST /api/admin/surveys`, `GET/PATCH /api/admin/surveys/[id]`; no screen yet.
